summary: Iteration 15 smoke regression on web preview: GREEN. Home (/) boots clean (23 track-rows, 3 mix cards, 0 errors, no Invariant Violation, no 'module not found' — react-native-android-widget import is harmless on web). Search flow: opened /search via bottom tab, typed 'Aaj Bhi 2 Vishal Mishra' (page.keyboard.type — Playwright fill() does NOT trigger onChangeText on RN TextInput web build), waited 6s, tapped suggest-entity-song-JBrx_OoJ via element.evaluate('el=>el.click()'). NOTE: the /search screen renders quick-suggest entities with testID pattern `suggest-entity-song-<id>` (see /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/search.tsx:259), NOT `track-row-<id>` — the review-request selector `track-row-JBrx_OoJ` does not exist on the search screen; the equivalent testID is `suggest-entity-song-JBrx_OoJ` and both fire the same playNow. Mini-player appeared with 'Aaj Bhi 2 · Vishal Mishra', opened player screen — player-tab-lyrics, player-tab-upnext, player-tab-related, player-play-toggle, player-next, player-prev all present. Lyrics tab renders lyrics-view AND lyrics-wordsync 'Word‑synced' pill (screenshot confirms both pills). Up Next tab renders full queue (Now Playing 'Aaj Bhi 2' + 10 upcoming: Tum Ho Toh, Deewaniyat, Jaan Ban Gaye, Pehle Bhi Main, Kaise Hua…). Session persistence: with liquidaudio.autoplay=false to isolate from web-only audio-decode auto-advance, session wrote 452 bytes (queue+index+current JBrx_OoJ), full page.goto('/') reload restored mini-player 'Aaj Bhi 2 · Vishal Mishra' within 7s, session bytes identical after reload. Zero fatal (non-audio, non-widget) errors; the only page-errors are the expected 'no supported source'/'Failed to load' audio-decode errors on web preview and 10 benign Reanimated layout-animation warnings on the Up Next entrance animation. No red screen. No react-native-android-widget import errors on web. No deprecated-prop warnings.
action_items: None blocking — web smoke regression is GREEN. Iteration 15 native features (patched expo-audio lock-screen controls + react-native-android-widget) are Android-native and cannot be exercised on web; a native Android build is required to validate lock-screen next/prev + home-screen widget task-handler. Recommend main agent produce an EAS dev-client (or `expo run:android`) build and manually verify.

Minor cosmetic (not from this iter): 10 [Reanimated] 'Properties [transform, opacity] may be overwritten by a layout animation' warnings fire when Up Next list mounts (FadeInDown entering animation on rows that also carry transform). Non-blocking; can be silenced by wrapping the Animated.View entering rows in an outer Animated.View that owns the layout animation, per Reanimated docs. Not a regression from this iteration.

Documentation nit: the review request selector `track-row-JBrx_OoJ` on the /search screen does not exist — /search uses `suggest-entity-song-<id>`. `track-row-<id>` is still used on Home / mix / playlist / artist / library screens (see /app/frontend/src/components/track-row.tsx:29). Recommend updating iteration test-notes to reflect the correct testID for search.
